messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.11-12
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl (1.11-12) has been released at its web site
(http://www.rqtl.org).

See http://www.rqtl.org/STATUS.txt for a list of changes.  There was
just one major change (see below).

Another important announcement: Saunak Sen and I have just completed a
book, "A guide to QTL mapping with R/qtl", which will be published by
Springer and will appear in early August.  See http://www.rqtl.org/book
for further details (including the table of contents and a sample
chapter).

Karl Broman
kbr...@biostat.wisc.edu

------

Version 1.11, 3/29/2009:

Major changes:

  Revised effectplot so that one may refer to "pseudomarkers" by their
  chromosome and position with a construction like "5...@32.8", rather
  than having to first call find.pseudomarker to get the name.  Also,
  in the actual plot, we use the form "5...@32.8" rather than, for
  example, "c5.loc47".
